title: AW27 Toddler Boys' Knit Shape and Fit Outlook
summary: Toddler boys' AW27 knits: merino sets, fleece, cardigans, sleepsuits.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-fair forecast. The AW27 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime Paris) take place in January 2027. This report applies the 2026 adult yarn, fabric and leather fair evidence and the AW26 kidswear fair record to kidswear, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- FashionUnited notes "kidult" knitwear with whimsical faces and regressive animal motifs and a customer raised on Y2K who buys playful charms<sup>[1]</sup>
- Pink and mauve are becoming gender-neutral, reaching menswear and even junior sweatshirts<sup>[2]</sup>
- Pitti Filati's AW27 research theme "Discipline" draws on equestrian codes: dressage (braided manes, saddle pads), Western reining (Quarter Horse spots, quilt geometry, denim, suede, flannel) and show jumping (stripes, colour blocking, technical knits)<sup>[3]</sup>

design_implications:
- Neck openings wide enough for easy dressing.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Sweatshirts and knits are reorder lines.
